items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: my daddy used to have Albert Glenny and...who was daddy called? MacNeil... Wendell MacNeil was his name... And my daddy and Albert Glenny. And they used to wake us up with serenaders.

ctx.x: You know what was wonderful? I guess I must have been a little girl about, oh, about nine years old. And my daddy used to have Albert Glenny and...who was daddy called? MacNeil.
